source.text: וַיְהִ֤י הַגּוֹרָל֙ לְמַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּי־ה֖וּא בְּכ֣וֹר יוֹסֵ֑ף לְמָכִיר֩ בְּכ֨וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה אֲבִ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֗ד כִּ֣י ה֤וּא הָיָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽיְהִי־ל֖וֹ הַגִּלְעָ֥ד וְהַבָּשָֽׁן׃

records.literal_gloss: And was the lot for [the] tribe of Manasseh, for he [was the] firstborn of Joseph; for Machir, [the] firstborn of Manasseh, [the] father of the Gilead, because he was a man of war, and were to him the Gilead and the Bashan.

en.L: And the lot was for the tribe of Manasseh, for he [was] the firstborn of Joseph. For Machir, the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, Gilead and Bashan were his.
en.B: This was the land that came by lot to the tribe of Manasseh, for he was Joseph's firstborn. Machir, Manasseh's firstborn and the father of Gilead, had Gilead and Bashan, because he was a warrior.
en.R: Next, land was given by lot to the tribe of Manasseh, Joseph's oldest son. Manasseh's oldest son Machir was the father of Gilead. Machir was a strong fighter, so he had already been given the lands of Gilead and Bashan, east of the Jordan River.

sw.L: Na kura ilikuwa kwa kabila la Manase, kwa maana yeye [alikuwa] mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yusufu. Kwa Makiri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Manase, baba wa Gileadi, kwa sababu alikuwa mtu wa vita, Gileadi na Bashani zilikuwa zake.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo nchi iliyoangukia kabila la Manase kwa kura, kwa maana yeye alikuwa mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Yusufu. Makiri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Manase na baba wa Gileadi, alikuwa na Gileadi na Bashani, kwa sababu alikuwa shujaa wa vita.
sw.R: Kisha kabila la Manase, mwana wa kwanza wa Yusufu, lilipewa nchi kwa kura. Makiri, mwana wa kwanza wa Manase, alikuwa baba wa Gileadi. Makiri alikuwa mpiganaji hodari, kwa hiyo alikuwa amekwisha kupewa nchi za Gileadi na Bashani, upande wa mashariki wa Mto Yordani.

es.L: Y la suerte fue para la tribu de Manasés, porque él [era] el primogénito de José. A Maquir, el primogénito de Manasés, padre de Galaad, porque era hombre de guerra, le tocaron Galaad y Basán.
es.B: Esta fue la tierra que le tocó por suerte a la tribu de Manasés, porque él era el primogénito de José. Maquir, primogénito de Manasés y padre de Galaad, tenía Galaad y Basán, porque era un guerrero.
es.R: Después se dio tierra por sorteo a la tribu de Manasés, el hijo mayor de José. Maquir, el hijo mayor de Manasés, era el padre de Galaad. Maquir era un gran guerrero, así que ya se le habían dado las tierras de Galaad y Basán, al este del río Jordán.

fr.L: Et le sort fut pour la tribu de Manassé, car il [était] le premier-né de Joseph. Pour Makir, le premier-né de Manassé, le père de Galaad, parce qu’il était un homme de guerre, Galaad et le Bashân furent à lui.
fr.B: Voici le territoire échu par le sort à la tribu de Manassé, car il était le premier-né de Joseph. Makir, premier-né de Manassé et père de Galaad, avait reçu Galaad et le Bashân, parce qu’il était un guerrier.
fr.R: Ensuite, des terres ont été données par tirage au sort à la tribu de Manassé, le fils aîné de Joseph. Le fils aîné de Manassé, Makir, était le père de Galaad. Makir était un grand combattant, et il avait donc déjà reçu les pays de Galaad et du Bashân, à l’est du Jourdain.

vi.L: Thăm [này] là cho chi tộc Ma-na-se, vì ông [là] con đầu lòng của Giô-sép. Về phần Ma-ki, con đầu lòng của Ma-na-se, cha của Ga-la-át, vì ông là một chiến binh, nên Ga-la-át và Ba-san thuộc về ông.
vi.B: Đây là phần đất bắt thăm được cho chi tộc Ma-na-se, vì Ma-na-se là con đầu lòng của Giô-sép. Ma-ki, con đầu lòng của Ma-na-se và là cha của Ga-la-át, đã có Ga-la-át và Ba-san, vì ông là một chiến binh.
vi.R: Tiếp theo, chi tộc Ma-na-se, con trưởng của Giô-sép, bắt thăm được đất. Con trưởng của Ma-na-se là Ma-ki, cha của Ga-la-át. Ma-ki là một chiến sĩ dũng mãnh, nên ông đã được ban đất Ga-la-át và Ba-san ở phía đông sông Giô-đanh rồi.

ko.L: 그리고 므낫세 지파에게 제비가 [뽑혔으니], 그가 요셉의 맏아들이었기 때문이다. 므낫세의 맏아들이며 길르앗의 아버지인 마길에게는, 그가 용사였기 때문에 길르앗과 바산이 그의 것이 되었다.
ko.B: 므낫세 지파가 제비 뽑아 받은 땅은 이러하다. 므낫세는 요셉의 맏아들이었다. 므낫세의 맏아들이며 길르앗의 아버지인 마길은 용사였으므로 길르앗과 바산을 차지하였다.
ko.R: 그다음에 므낫세 지파가 제비를 뽑아 땅을 받았다. 므낫세는 요셉의 맏아들이었다. 므낫세의 맏아들 마길은 길르앗의 아버지였다. 마길은 용감한 군인이었으므로, 이미 요단강 동쪽의 길르앗과 바산 땅을 받았다.

decisions.choice: the lot: the share of land decided by casting lots
decisions.reason: The land west of the Jordan was shared out among the tribes by lot, so that the LORD, not the leaders, decided each tribe's place (Numbers 26:52-56; 33:54; Joshua 14:1-2). The word "lot" can mean both the object cast and the share it gave; here it is the share. Joshua 16:1 opens the lot of Joseph's descendants, and this verse turns to the part of it that fell to Manasseh.

decisions.choice: the firstborn of Joseph: Manasseh was Joseph's elder son
decisions.reason: Manasseh was born before Ephraim (Genesis 41:51-52), though Jacob gave the younger son the greater blessing (Genesis 48:13-20), and Ephraim's share is described first (Joshua 16:5-10). The verse gives Manasseh's birthright as the reason he too receives a full share, beside the land already given east of the Jordan.

decisions.choice: Machir received Gilead and Bashan: the land east of the Jordan, given earlier
decisions.reason: Machir's clan had taken Gilead, and Moses gave it to them (Numbers 32:39-40; Deuteronomy 3:13-15; Joshua 13:29-31). Bashan was the land north of Gilead, east of the Sea of Chinnereth. The verse recalls that gift and gives the reason for it: Machir was a fighting man. The lot described in the rest of the chapter is for the other clans, west of the Jordan (verse 2).

decisions.choice: the father of Gilead: Gilead is both a man and a land
decisions.reason: Gilead was Machir's son (Numbers 26:29), and the region east of the Jordan bore the same name. In this verse "Gilead" first names the man, then the land.

decisions.choice: a warrior / a strong fighter
decisions.reason: "A man of war" means a fighting man, a warrior; Balanced and Readable say so in one word or phrase. Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: had already been given ... east of the Jordan River
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that this gift was made before the lot (m3) and where the land lay, as verse 5 says. Literal and Balanced leave it to the reader.

source.text: וַ֠יְהִי לִבְנֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה הַנּוֹתָרִים֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לִבְנֵ֨י אֲבִיעֶ֜זֶר וְלִבְנֵי־חֵ֗לֶק וְלִבְנֵ֤י אַשְׂרִיאֵל֙ וְלִבְנֵי־שֶׁ֔כֶם וְלִבְנֵי־חֵ֖פֶר וְלִבְנֵ֣י שְׁמִידָ֑ע אֵ֠לֶּה בְּנֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֧ה בֶּן־יוֹסֵ֛ף הַזְּכָרִ֖ים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the lot] for [the] sons of Manasseh the remaining by their clans: for [the] sons of Abiezer and for [the] sons of Helek and for [the] sons of Asriel and for [the] sons of Shechem and for [the] sons of Hepher and for [the] sons of Shemida; these [are the] sons of Manasseh son of Joseph, the males, by their clans.

en.L: And [the lot] was for the rest of the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Manasseh by their clans: for the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Abiezer and for the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Helek and for the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Asriel and for the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Shechem and for the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Hepher and for the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Shemida. These [were] the sons of Manasseh son of Joseph, the males, by their clans.
en.B: The lot was also for the rest of Manasseh's descendants, clan by clan: the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These were the male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, listed by their clans.
en.R: The rest of Manasseh's descendants also received land by lot, one share for each clan. The clans were named after Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These were the clans of Manasseh, Joseph's son, counted through the men of each family.

sw.L: Na [kura] ilikuwa kwa wana wa Manase waliobaki kufuatana na koo zao: kwa wana wa Abiezeri na kwa wana wa Heleki na kwa wana wa Asrieli na kwa wana wa Shekemu na kwa wana wa Heferi na kwa wana wa Shemida. Hawa [ndio] wana wa Manase mwana wa Yusufu, wanaume, kufuatana na koo zao.
sw.B: Kura ilikuwa pia kwa wazao wengine wa Manase, ukoo kwa ukoo: koo za Abiezeri, Heleki, Asrieli, Shekemu, Heferi na Shemida. Hao ndio waliokuwa wazao wa kiume wa Manase mwana wa Yusufu, wakiorodheshwa kwa koo zao.
sw.R: Wazao wengine wa Manase nao walipokea nchi kwa kura, fungu moja kwa kila ukoo. Koo hizo ziliitwa kwa majina ya Abiezeri, Heleki, Asrieli, Shekemu, Heferi na Shemida. Hizo ndizo koo za Manase mwana wa Yusufu, zilizohesabiwa kupitia wanaume wa kila jamaa.

es.L: Y [la suerte] fue para el resto de los hijos de Manasés conforme a sus clanes: para los hijos de Abiezer, y para los hijos de Helec, y para los hijos de Asriel, y para los hijos de Siquem, y para los hijos de Hefer, y para los hijos de Semida. Estos [eran] los hijos de Manasés hijo de José, los varones, conforme a sus clanes.
es.B: La suerte fue también para el resto de los descendientes de Manasés, clan por clan: los clanes de Abiezer, Helec, Asriel, Siquem, Hefer y Semida. Estos eran los descendientes varones de Manasés hijo de José, por sus clanes.
es.R: El resto de los descendientes de Manasés también recibió tierra por sorteo, una parte para cada clan. Los clanes llevaban el nombre de Abiezer, Helec, Asriel, Siquem, Hefer y Semida. Estos eran los clanes de Manasés, el hijo de José, contados por los hombres de cada familia.

fr.L: Et [le sort] fut pour le reste des {{gender:descendants|fils}} de Manassé selon leurs clans : pour les {{gender:descendants|fils}} d’Abiézer, et pour les {{gender:descendants|fils}} de Hélek, et pour les {{gender:descendants|fils}} d’Asriel, et pour les {{gender:descendants|fils}} de Sichem, et pour les {{gender:descendants|fils}} de Hépher, et pour les {{gender:descendants|fils}} de Shemida. Ceux-là [étaient] les fils de Manassé, fils de Joseph, les mâles, selon leurs clans.
fr.B: Le sort fut aussi pour le reste des descendants de Manassé, clan par clan : les clans d’Abiézer, de Hélek, d’Asriel, de Sichem, de Hépher et de Shemida. C’étaient les descendants mâles de Manassé, fils de Joseph, rangés par clans.
fr.R: Le reste des descendants de Manassé a aussi reçu des terres par tirage au sort, une part pour chaque clan. Les clans portaient les noms d’Abiézer, de Hélek, d’Asriel, de Sichem, de Hépher et de Shemida. C’étaient les clans de Manassé, fils de Joseph, comptés par les hommes de chaque famille.

vi.L: [Thăm] cũng là cho những con cháu còn lại của Ma-na-se theo các gia tộc của họ: cho con cháu A-bi-ê-xe, cho con cháu Hê-léc, cho con cháu Ách-ri-ên, cho con cháu Si-chem, cho con cháu Hê-phe, và cho con cháu Sê-mi-đa. Đó [là] các con trai của Ma-na-se con trai Giô-sép, những người nam, theo các gia tộc của họ.
vi.B: Thăm cũng được bắt cho những con cháu còn lại của Ma-na-se, theo từng gia tộc: các gia tộc A-bi-ê-xe, Hê-léc, Ách-ri-ên, Si-chem, Hê-phe và Sê-mi-đa. Đó là con cháu nam của Ma-na-se con trai Giô-sép, kể theo từng gia tộc.
vi.R: Những con cháu còn lại của Ma-na-se cũng bắt thăm được đất, mỗi gia tộc một phần. Các gia tộc ấy mang tên A-bi-ê-xe, Hê-léc, Ách-ri-ên, Si-chem, Hê-phe và Sê-mi-đa. Đó là các gia tộc của Ma-na-se, con trai Giô-sép, được tính theo những người nam trong mỗi gia đình.

ko.L: 그리고 므낫세의 나머지 자손에게 그들의 종족대로 [제비가 뽑혔으니], 아비에셀 자손과 헬렉 자손과 아스리엘 자손과 세겜 자손과 헤벨 자손과 스미다 자손에게였다. 이들이 요셉의 아들 므낫세의 자손 가운데 남자들이니, 그들의 종족대로이다.
ko.B: 므낫세의 나머지 자손도 종족별로 제비 뽑아 땅을 받았으니, 아비에셀과 헬렉과 아스리엘과 세겜과 헤벨과 스미다 종족이다. 이들이 요셉의 아들 므낫세의 남자 자손으로, 종족별로 적은 것이다.
ko.R: 므낫세의 나머지 자손도 종족마다 한 몫씩 제비를 뽑아 땅을 받았다. 그 종족들의 이름은 아비에셀, 헬렉, 아스리엘, 세겜, 헤벨, 스미다였다. 이들이 요셉의 아들 므낫세의 종족들인데, 집안마다 남자들을 따라 센 것이다.

decisions.choice: Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, Shemida: the six clans of Gilead
decisions.reason: These are the clans descended from Gilead son of Machir in the census of Numbers 26:30-32, where Abiezer is called by the short form Iezer. They are the clans that settle west of the Jordan. Gideon later came from the clan of Abiezer (Judges 6:11, 34), and Shechem is also the name of a town in Manasseh's hill country (verse 7).

decisions.choice: the rest of the descendants of Manasseh: those who had no land yet
decisions.reason: "The rest" are the clans not already given land with Machir east of the Jordan (verse 1). The same word comes back in verse 6.

decisions.choice: the males: the clans counted through their men
decisions.reason: The list ends by saying these were "the males", the sons through whom each clan's line was traced. It prepares for verse 3, where one man of the clan of Hepher had no sons, only daughters, and yet his line received land.

decisions.choice: descendants (clans) / sons, the males
decisions.reason: The "sons" of each clan are the clan's people, so Literal gives "descendants" with "sons" as the traditional form, and Balanced and Readable name the clans. In the last sentence the verse itself says "the males", so every level keeps a male word there and no inclusive form is offered.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de" (L), "los descendientes de" (B, R), with no gender span; "los varones" for "the males"
alternatives: a gender span as in English
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" and "descendientes" already take in daughters, so the English span on "descendants" / "sons" has no Spanish counterpart. "The males" is "los varones", as in Numbers 1, since the clans are counted through the men (m-decisions); the daughters of Zelophehad in the next verse are the exception.

decisions.choice: gender setting at Literal for the clans: default "descendants", alternative "fils", as the English
decisions.reason: The clans are named after their ancestors and include women as well as men; French "descendants" says so, with "fils" as the traditional alternative. "Les mâles" at the end of the verse is kept at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says the clans were counted through the men, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "con cháu" for the "sons" of each clan father at Literal, with no gender span
decisions.reason: "con cháu" means descendants and takes in men and women; the closing "những người nam" keeps the Hebrew note that the clans were counted through the men.

source.text: וְלִצְלָפְחָד֩ בֶּן־חֵ֨פֶר בֶּן־גִּלְעָ֜ד בֶּן־מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לֹא־הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנ֑וֹת וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֹתָ֔יו מַחְלָ֣ה וְנֹעָ֔ה חָגְלָ֥ה מִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And to Zelophehad son of Hepher son of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh not were to him sons, but only daughters; and these [are the] names of his daughters: Mahlah and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.

en.L: But Zelophehad son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, had no sons, only daughters; and these [are] the names of his daughters: Mahlah and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.
en.B: But Zelophehad son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, had no sons, only daughters. His daughters were named Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.
en.R: But Zelophehad had no sons. He had only daughters. He was the son of Hepher, and Hepher was a descendant of Gilead, Machir and Manasseh. Zelophehad's daughters were named Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.

sw.L: Lakini Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase, hakuwa na wana, ila binti tu; na haya [ndiyo] majina ya binti zake: Mahla na Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa.
sw.B: Lakini Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase, hakuwa na wana wa kiume, ila binti tu. Binti zake waliitwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa.
sw.R: Lakini Selofehadi hakuwa na wana wa kiume. Alikuwa na binti tu. Yeye alikuwa mwana wa Heferi, na Heferi alikuwa mzao wa Gileadi, Makiri na Manase. Binti za Selofehadi waliitwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa.

es.L: Pero Zelofehad hijo de Hefer, hijo de Galaad, hijo de Maquir, hijo de Manasés, no tuvo hijos, sino solo hijas; y estos [son] los nombres de sus hijas: Maala y Noa, Hogla, Milca y Tirsa.
es.B: Pero Zelofehad hijo de Hefer, hijo de Galaad, hijo de Maquir, hijo de Manasés, no tuvo hijos varones, sino solo hijas. Sus hijas se llamaban Maala, Noa, Hogla, Milca y Tirsa.
es.R: Pero Zelofehad no tuvo hijos varones. Solo tuvo hijas. Era hijo de Hefer, y Hefer era descendiente de Galaad, de Maquir y de Manasés. Las hijas de Zelofehad se llamaban Maala, Noa, Hogla, Milca y Tirsa.

fr.L: Mais Tselophehad, fils de Hépher, fils de Galaad, fils de Makir, fils de Manassé, n’eut pas de fils, mais seulement des filles ; et voici les noms de ses filles : Mahla et Noa, Hogla, Milka et Tirtsa.
fr.B: Mais Tselophehad, fils de Hépher, fils de Galaad, fils de Makir, fils de Manassé, n’avait pas de fils, seulement des filles. Ses filles s’appelaient Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka et Tirtsa.
fr.R: Mais Tselophehad n’avait pas de fils. Il avait seulement des filles. Il était le fils de Hépher, et Hépher était un descendant de Galaad, de Makir et de Manassé. Les filles de Tselophehad s’appelaient Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka et Tirtsa.

vi.L: Nhưng Xê-lô-phát con trai Hê-phe, con trai Ga-la-át, con trai Ma-ki, con trai Ma-na-se, không có con trai, chỉ có con gái; và đây [là] tên các con gái ông: Mách-la và Nô-a, Hốt-la, Minh-ca và Thiệt-sa.
vi.B: Nhưng Xê-lô-phát con trai Hê-phe, con trai Ga-la-át, con trai Ma-ki, con trai Ma-na-se, không có con trai mà chỉ có con gái. Các con gái ông tên là Mách-la, Nô-a, Hốt-la, Minh-ca và Thiệt-sa.
vi.R: Nhưng Xê-lô-phát không có con trai. Ông chỉ có con gái. Ông là con trai Hê-phe, và Hê-phe là dòng dõi của Ga-la-át, Ma-ki và Ma-na-se. Các con gái của Xê-lô-phát tên là Mách-la, Nô-a, Hốt-la, Minh-ca và Thiệt-sa.

ko.L: 그러나 므낫세의 아들 마길의 아들 길르앗의 아들 헤벨의 아들 슬로브핫에게는 아들이 없고 딸들만 있었다. 그리고 그의 딸들의 이름은 이러하다. 말라와 노아, 호글라, 밀가와 디르사.
ko.B: 그러나 므낫세의 아들 마길의 아들 길르앗의 아들 헤벨의 아들 슬로브핫에게는 아들이 없고 딸들만 있었다. 그 딸들의 이름은 말라, 노아, 호글라, 밀가, 디르사였다.
ko.R: 그런데 슬로브핫에게는 아들이 없고 딸들만 있었다. 그는 헤벨의 아들이었고, 헤벨은 길르앗과 마길과 므낫세의 자손이었다. 슬로브핫의 딸들의 이름은 말라, 노아, 호글라, 밀가, 디르사였다.

decisions.choice: Zelophehad had no sons, only daughters: the case settled in Numbers 27 and 36
decisions.reason: The census named Zelophehad's five daughters (Numbers 26:33). They asked Moses for their father's share, and the LORD ruled that it should pass to them (Numbers 27:1-11); later he ruled that they must marry within their father's tribe, so the land would stay in Manasseh (Numbers 36:1-12). Verses 3-6 tell how that ruling was carried out when the land was shared.

decisions.choice: but only daughters
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 26:33, the words "but if" after a negative mean "only": he had daughters and no sons.

decisions.choice: Noah: a woman's name, not the Noah of the flood
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 26:33, this name is spelled differently in Hebrew from the name of Noah in Genesis 6-9.

decisions.choice: Mahlah and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah (L); the names as in Numbers 26:33 and 27:1
decisions.reason: The names are given in the same order as in Numbers 26:33 and 27:1, with the same joining words at Literal; Readable traces the family line as Numbers 27:1 does.

decisions.choice: "Zelofehad"; "Maala, Noa, Hogla, Milca y Tirsa"
decisions.reason: The daughters of Numbers 26:33 and 27:1, in their usual Spanish forms. Balanced and Readable say "hijos varones", since Spanish "hijos" alone could include the daughters the verse goes on to name.

decisions.choice: the daughters' names as "Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka et Tirtsa"
decisions.reason: These women are named in Numbers 26:33 and 27:1; their names follow the same transcription as the other minor names in this translation. "Noa" is a woman's name, kept apart from "Noé" of the flood, as the meaning decision explains.

source.text: וַתִּקְרַ֡בְנָה לִפְנֵי֩ אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י׀יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֗וּן וְלִפְנֵ֤י הַנְּשִׂיאִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָֽתֶת־לָ֥נוּ נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ אַחֵ֑ינוּ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֜ם אֶל־פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ נַֽחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֥י אֲבִיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And they drew near before Eleazar the priest and before Joshua son of Nun and before the leaders, saying, Yahweh commanded Moses to give to us an inheritance in [the] midst of our brothers; and he gave to them, at [the] mouth of Yahweh, an inheritance in [the] midst of [the] brothers of their father.

en.L: And they drew near before Eleazar the priest and before Joshua son of Nun and before the leaders, saying, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers." And he gave them, at the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, an inheritance among the brothers of their father.
en.B: They came forward before Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the leaders. "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} commanded Moses," they said, "to give us an inheritance among our relatives." So Joshua gave them an inheritance among their father's brothers, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded.
en.R: They went to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the leaders. They said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} commanded Moses to give us land of our own among our relatives." So Joshua did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded. He gave them land among their father's relatives.

sw.L: Na wakakaribia mbele ya Eleazari kuhani na mbele ya Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na mbele ya viongozi, wakisema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwamuru Musa atupe urithi katikati ya ndugu zetu." Naye akawapa, kwa kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, urithi katikati ya ndugu wa baba yao.
sw.B: Walikuja mbele ya Eleazari kuhani, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na viongozi. Wakasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwamuru Musa atupe urithi kati ya jamaa zetu." Basi Yoshua akawapa urithi kati ya ndugu wa baba yao, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa ameamuru.
sw.R: Walikwenda kwa Eleazari kuhani, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na viongozi. Wakasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwamuru Musa atupe nchi yetu wenyewe kati ya jamaa zetu." Basi Yoshua akafanya kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa ameamuru. Aliwapa nchi kati ya jamaa za baba yao.

es.L: Y se acercaron ante el sacerdote Eleazar, y ante Josué hijo de Nun, y ante los jefes, diciendo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mandó a Moisés que nos diera heredad en medio de nuestros hermanos». Y les dio, conforme a la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, heredad en medio de los hermanos de su padre.
es.B: Se presentaron ante el sacerdote Eleazar, ante Josué hijo de Nun y ante los jefes, y dijeron: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mandó a Moisés que nos diera una heredad entre nuestros parientes». Así que Josué les dio una heredad entre los hermanos de su padre, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado.
es.R: Fueron a ver al sacerdote Eleazar, a Josué hijo de Nun y a los jefes. Les dijeron: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le mandó a Moisés que nos diera tierra propia entre nuestros parientes». Así que Josué hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado. Les dio tierra entre los parientes de su padre.

fr.L: Et elles s’approchèrent devant Éléazar le prêtre, et devant Josué fils de Noun, et devant les chefs, en disant : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a ordonné à Moïse de nous donner un héritage au milieu de nos frères. » Et il leur donna, selon la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, un héritage au milieu des frères de leur père.
fr.B: Elles se présentèrent devant Éléazar le prêtre, Josué fils de Noun et les chefs. « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a ordonné à Moïse, dirent-elles, de nous donner un héritage parmi nos parents. » Josué leur donna donc un héritage parmi les frères de leur père, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné.
fr.R: Elles sont allées trouver Éléazar le prêtre, Josué fils de Noun et les chefs. Elles leur ont dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a ordonné à Moïse de nous donner une terre à nous parmi nos parents. » Alors Josué a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait ordonné. Il leur a donné une terre parmi les parents de leur père.

vi.L: Họ đến gần trước mặt thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa, trước mặt Giô-suê con trai Nun và trước mặt các thủ lĩnh mà nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho Môi-se ban cho chúng tôi một sản nghiệp giữa anh em chúng tôi." Vậy ông ban cho họ, theo miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, một sản nghiệp giữa anh em của cha họ.
vi.B: Họ đến trước mặt thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa, Giô-suê con trai Nun và các thủ lĩnh mà nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho Môi-se ban cho chúng tôi một sản nghiệp giữa bà con chúng tôi." Vậy Giô-suê ban cho họ một sản nghiệp giữa các chú bác của họ, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền.
vi.R: Họ đến gặp thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa, Giô-suê con trai Nun và các thủ lĩnh. Họ nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho Môi-se ban cho chúng tôi phần đất riêng giữa bà con chúng tôi." Vậy Giô-suê làm theo điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền. Ông ban cho họ phần đất giữa bà con bên nội của họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 제사장 엘르아살 앞과 눈의 아들 여호수아 앞과 지도자들 앞에 나아와 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세에게 명령하시어 우리 형제들 가운데서 우리에게 유산을 주라고 하셨습니다." 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령대로 그들에게 그들의 아버지의 형제들 가운데서 유산을 주었다.
ko.B: 그들이 제사장 엘르아살과 눈의 아들 여호수아와 지도자들 앞에 나아와 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세에게 명령하시기를, 우리 친척들 가운데서 우리에게도 유산을 주라고 하셨습니다." 그래서 여호수아는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 명령하신 대로 그들에게 아버지의 형제들 가운데서 유산을 주었다.
ko.R: 그들은 제사장 엘르아살과 눈의 아들 여호수아와 지도자들에게 가서 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세에게, 우리 친척들 가운데서 우리에게도 땅을 주라고 명령하셨습니다." 그래서 여호수아는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 명령하신 대로 하였다. 그는 그들에게 아버지의 친척들 가운데서 땅을 주었다.

decisions.choice: the LORD commanded Moses: the ruling of Numbers 27:6-7
decisions.reason: The daughters remind the leaders of the LORD's words to Moses: "You shall surely give them a possession of inheritance among the brothers of their father" (Numbers 27:7). Moses had died, so they bring the ruling to those now sharing out the land: Eleazar, Joshua and the tribal leaders, the very people named for that task (Numbers 34:17-18; Joshua 14:1).

decisions.choice: among our brothers: among the men of our clan
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here are kinsmen, the male relatives of their clan, as in Numbers 27:4, 7. The daughters ask to hold land beside their father's brothers, in their father's place.

decisions.choice: he gave them: Joshua, acting for the leaders
decisions.reason: The verb is singular and has no named subject. Joshua is the one who carries out the sharing of the land in these chapters (14:13; 15:13), so he is the most likely subject; the priest and the leaders act with him.

decisions.choice: at the mouth of the LORD: by the LORD's command
decisions.reason: "Mouth" stands for what someone says. The phrase means that the gift was made just as the LORD had ordered, as in Numbers 9:18 and 33:2.

decisions.choice: Joshua
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Joshua as the one who gave the land (m3); Literal keeps "he".

decisions.choice: our relatives; their father's brothers (B) / relatives (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "relatives" for the daughters' own words, since they mean their kinsmen, and keeps "their father's brothers" in the narrator's words, as in Numbers 27:7. Readable says "relatives" for both, and "land of our own" for the inheritance, as Numbers 27:4 does.

decisions.choice: "bà con" (Balanced, Readable) for "our brothers"; "các chú bác" (Balanced) and "bà con bên nội" (Readable) for "their father's brothers"
decisions.reason: The brothers are the men of their clan (meaning decision); Vietnamese names the father's side plainly. Literal keeps "anh em".

decisions.choice: The daughters speak to the priest and the leaders in the formal polite style (합쇼체), calling themselves "우리"
decisions.reason: They come before Israel's leaders with a request, so they speak up to them (style guide section 4). "우리" keeps the Hebrew "us ... our brothers", which ties them to their clan.

source.text: וַיִּפְּל֥וּ חַבְלֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֑ה לְבַ֞ד מֵאֶ֤רֶץ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְהַבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And fell [the] portions of Manasseh ten, apart from [the] land of the Gilead and the Bashan which [is] from [the] other side of the Jordan,

en.L: And ten portions fell to Manasseh, apart from the land of Gilead and Bashan, which [is] across the Jordan,
en.B: So ten shares fell to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan across the Jordan,
en.R: So Manasseh received ten shares of land west of the Jordan River. This was in addition to Gilead and Bashan on the east side of the river.

sw.L: Na mafungu kumi yakamwangukia Manase, mbali na nchi ya Gileadi na Bashani, iliyo ng'ambo ya Yordani,
sw.B: Hivyo mafungu kumi yalimwangukia Manase, zaidi ya nchi ya Gileadi na Bashani iliyo ng'ambo ya Yordani,
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Manase walipokea mafungu kumi ya nchi upande wa magharibi wa Mto Yordani. Hayo yalikuwa zaidi ya Gileadi na Bashani, zilizo upande wa mashariki wa mto.

es.L: Y cayeron a Manasés diez porciones, aparte de la tierra de Galaad y Basán, que [está] al otro lado del Jordán,
es.B: Así le tocaron a Manasés diez partes, además de la tierra de Galaad y Basán, al otro lado del Jordán,
es.R: Así que Manasés recibió diez partes de tierra al oeste del río Jordán. Esto era además de Galaad y Basán, al lado este del río.

fr.L: Et dix parts échurent à Manassé, à part le pays de Galaad et du Bashân, qui [est] au-delà du Jourdain,
fr.B: Dix parts échurent ainsi à Manassé, sans compter le pays de Galaad et du Bashân, de l’autre côté du Jourdain,
fr.R: Manassé a donc reçu dix parts de terre à l’ouest du Jourdain. Cela s’ajoutait à Galaad et au Bashân, à l’est du fleuve.

vi.L: Mười phần rơi vào Ma-na-se, ngoài đất Ga-la-át và Ba-san ở bên kia sông Giô-đanh,
vi.B: Vậy Ma-na-se được mười phần, ngoài đất Ga-la-át và Ba-san ở bên kia sông Giô-đanh,
vi.R: Vì thế Ma-na-se nhận được mười phần đất ở phía tây sông Giô-đanh. Phần này là ngoài Ga-la-át và Ba-san ở phía đông sông.

ko.L: 그리고 요단 건너편에 있는 길르앗과 바산 땅 외에 므낫세에게 열 몫이 떨어졌다.
ko.B: 그래서 요단강 건너편의 길르앗과 바산 땅 외에도, 므낫세에게 열 몫이 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 므낫세 지파는 요단강 서쪽에서 열 몫의 땅을 받았다. 이것은 요단강 동쪽에 있는 길르앗과 바산 땅과는 따로 받은 것이다.

decisions.choice: portions fell: shares of land came by lot
decisions.reason: The word for "portion" first means a measuring cord, then the piece of land measured out with it. A portion "falls" to someone because it is given by lot, as the lot falls (Psalm 16:6 uses both pictures).

decisions.choice: ten portions: five clans and five daughters
decisions.reason: Six clans are named in verse 2. Hepher's line passed to Zelophehad, who had no sons, so his share went to his five daughters. The five other clans and the five daughters make ten shares, which verse 6 explains. This is the most natural way to count them; the text does not list the ten.

decisions.choice: across the Jordan: east of the river
decisions.reason: The phrase means "on the other side of the Jordan". Joshua is speaking from the land west of the river, so it means the east side, where Gilead and Bashan lay (verse 1; 13:29-31).

decisions.choice: west of the Jordan River ... on the east side of the river
decisions.reason: Readable says where each part of Manasseh's land lay, so the reader can see that the ten shares were in addition to the land east of the Jordan. It ends its sentence here, while Literal and Balanced run on into verse 6.

source.text: כִּ֚י בְּנ֣וֹת מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה נָחֲל֥וּ נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ בָּנָ֑יו וְאֶ֨רֶץ֙ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד הָיְתָ֥ה לִבְנֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה הַנּֽוֹתָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: for [the] daughters of Manasseh inherited an inheritance in [the] midst of his sons; and [the] land of the Gilead was for [the] sons of Manasseh the remaining.

en.L: for the daughters of Manasseh inherited an inheritance among his sons; and the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Manasseh.
en.B: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance along with his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of Manasseh's descendants.
en.R: That was because the women from Manasseh's family line, Zelophehad's daughters, received land along with the men. The land of Gilead went to the rest of Manasseh's descendants.

sw.L: kwa maana binti za Manase walirithi urithi katikati ya wanawe; na nchi ya Gileadi ilikuwa ya wana wa Manase waliobaki.
sw.B: kwa sababu binti za Manase walipokea urithi pamoja na wanawe. Nchi ya Gileadi ilikuwa mali ya wazao wengine wa Manase.
sw.R: Hiyo ilikuwa kwa sababu wanawake wa ukoo wa Manase, yaani binti za Selofehadi, walipokea nchi pamoja na wanaume. Nchi ya Gileadi iliwaendea wazao wengine wa Manase.

es.L: porque las hijas de Manasés heredaron heredad en medio de sus hijos; y la tierra de Galaad fue para el resto de los hijos de Manasés.
es.B: porque las hijas de Manasés recibieron heredad junto con sus hijos. La tierra de Galaad fue para el resto de los descendientes de Manasés.
es.R: Eso fue porque las mujeres de la familia de Manasés, las hijas de Zelofehad, recibieron tierra junto con los hombres. La tierra de Galaad fue para el resto de los descendientes de Manasés.

fr.L: car les filles de Manassé reçurent un héritage au milieu de ses fils ; et le pays de Galaad fut au reste des {{gender:descendants|fils}} de Manassé.
fr.B: parce que les filles de Manassé reçurent un héritage avec ses fils. Le pays de Galaad appartenait au reste des descendants de Manassé.
fr.R: C’était parce que des femmes de la famille de Manassé, les filles de Tselophehad, ont reçu des terres avec les hommes. Le pays de Galaad est revenu au reste des descendants de Manassé.

vi.L: vì các con gái của Ma-na-se đã nhận sản nghiệp giữa các con trai ông; còn đất Ga-la-át thuộc về những con cháu còn lại của Ma-na-se.
vi.B: vì các con gái của Ma-na-se đã nhận sản nghiệp cùng với các con trai ông. Đất Ga-la-át thuộc về những con cháu còn lại của Ma-na-se.
vi.R: Đó là vì những người nữ thuộc dòng dõi Ma-na-se, tức là các con gái Xê-lô-phát, đã nhận đất cùng với những người nam. Đất Ga-la-át thuộc về những con cháu còn lại của Ma-na-se.

ko.L: 므낫세의 딸들이 그의 아들들 가운데서 유산을 받았기 때문이다. 그리고 길르앗 땅은 므낫세의 나머지 자손에게 속하였다.
ko.B: 므낫세의 딸들이 아들들과 함께 유산을 받았기 때문이다. 길르앗 땅은 므낫세의 나머지 자손에게 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 므낫세 집안의 여자들, 곧 슬로브핫의 딸들이 남자들과 함께 땅을 받았기 때문이다. 길르앗 땅은 므낫세의 나머지 자손에게 돌아갔다.

decisions.choice: the daughters of Manasseh ... his sons: his female and male descendants
decisions.reason: "Daughters" and "sons" here mean descendants, as "sons of Israel" means Israelites. The daughters are Zelophehad's five daughters (verse 3), set beside the men who led the other clans.

decisions.choice: the rest of the descendants of Manasseh: the clan of Machir
decisions.reason: In verse 2, "the rest" were the clans settling west of the Jordan. Here "the rest" are those not just named, the people of Machir, who had Gilead east of the river (verse 1). The word points to whichever group has not yet been mentioned.

decisions.choice: the women from Manasseh's family line, Zelophehad's daughters
decisions.reason: Readable names the daughters of verse 3, so that "daughters of Manasseh" is not taken to mean Manasseh's own children.

source.text: וַיְהִ֤י גְבוּל־מְנַשֶּׁה֙ מֵֽאָשֵׁ֔ר הַֽמִּכְמְתָ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם וְהָלַ֤ךְ הַגְּבוּל֙ אֶל־הַיָּמִ֔ין אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י עֵ֥ין תַּפּֽוּחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] border of Manasseh from Asher [to] the Michmethath which [is] on [the] face of Shechem, and went the border to the right, to [the] inhabitants of En-tappuah.

en.L: And the border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which [is] facing Shechem; and the border goes to the right, to the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
en.B: The border of Manasseh ran from Asher to Michmethath, east of Shechem. From there the border goes south toward the people of En-tappuah.
en.R: Manasseh's border started at Asher and went to Michmethath, east of the town of Shechem. Then it turned south toward the people who lived in En-tappuah.

sw.L: Na mpaka wa Manase ulikuwa kutoka Asheri hadi Mikmethathi, ulio mkabala na Shekemu; na mpaka unaenda upande wa kulia, hadi wakaaji wa En-tapua.
sw.B: Mpaka wa Manase ulianzia Asheri hadi Mikmethathi, mashariki ya Shekemu. Kutoka hapo mpaka unaenda kusini kuelekea watu wa En-tapua.
sw.R: Mpaka wa Manase ulianzia Asheri, ukaenda hadi Mikmethathi, mashariki ya mji wa Shekemu. Kisha ukageuka kusini kuelekea watu walioishi En-tapua.

es.L: Y la frontera de Manasés fue desde Aser hasta Micmetat, que [está] frente a Siquem; y va la frontera hacia la derecha, hacia los habitantes de En-tapúa.
es.B: La frontera de Manasés iba desde Aser hasta Micmetat, al oriente de Siquem. De allí la frontera va hacia el sur, hacia la gente de En-tapúa.
es.R: La frontera de Manasés empezaba en Aser e iba hasta Micmetat, al este del pueblo de Siquem. Luego giraba hacia el sur, hacia la gente que vivía en En-tapúa.

fr.L: Et la frontière de Manassé fut depuis Aser jusqu’à Mikmethath, qui [est] en face de Sichem ; et la frontière va vers la droite, vers les habitants d’En-Tappouah.
fr.B: La frontière de Manassé allait d’Aser jusqu’à Mikmethath, à l’est de Sichem. De là, la frontière va vers le sud, vers les habitants d’En-Tappouah.
fr.R: La frontière de Manassé commençait à Aser et allait jusqu’à Mikmethath, à l’est de la ville de Sichem. Puis elle tournait vers le sud, vers les habitants d’En-Tappouah.

vi.L: Ranh giới của Ma-na-se là từ A-se đến Mích-mê-thát, [nơi] đối diện Si-chem; và ranh giới đi về bên phải, đến dân cư Ên-Tháp-bu-a.
vi.B: Ranh giới của Ma-na-se chạy từ A-se đến Mích-mê-thát, phía đông Si-chem. Từ đó ranh giới đi về phía nam, hướng về dân cư Ên-Tháp-bu-a.
vi.R: Ranh giới của Ma-na-se bắt đầu ở A-se và đi đến Mích-mê-thát, phía đông thị trấn Si-chem. Rồi nó quay về phía nam, hướng về dân sống tại Ên-Tháp-bu-a.

ko.L: 그리고 므낫세의 경계는 아셀에서 세겜 앞에 있는 믹므다까지였다. 그리고 경계는 오른쪽으로 엔답부아 주민들에게로 간다.
ko.B: 므낫세의 경계는 아셀에서 세겜 동쪽에 있는 믹므다까지였다. 거기에서 경계는 남쪽으로 엔답부아 주민들 쪽으로 간다.
ko.R: 므낫세의 경계는 아셀에서 시작하여 세겜 성읍 동쪽에 있는 믹므다까지 갔다. 그리고 남쪽으로 돌아 엔답부아에 사는 사람들 쪽으로 갔다.

decisions.choice: Asher: here probably a place, not the tribe
decisions.reason: The border is traced from one point to the next, so Asher here seems to be a town or district on Manasseh's southern edge. The tribe of Asher lay far to the north-west (verse 10; 19:24-31). Its site is not known.

decisions.choice: Michmethath, Shechem, En-tappuah: points on the line between Manasseh and Ephraim
decisions.reason: Michmethath also marks Ephraim's border (16:6). Shechem was the well-known town between Mount Ebal and Mount Gerizim (Genesis 12:6; Joshua 24:1). En-tappuah, "spring of Tappuah", was near the town of Tappuah (verse 8; 16:8). The line described here is the same boundary as in 16:5-8, seen from Manasseh's side.

decisions.choice: on the face of: east of, facing
decisions.reason: "On the face of" a place often means in front of it, and since a person faced east to find directions, it can mean east of it (Genesis 23:19). Here it most likely means east of Shechem.

decisions.choice: to the right: south
decisions.reason: Facing east, the right hand is south. The word for "right hand" is used for the south, as in Psalm 89:13.

decisions.choice: east of; south
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the directions plainly (m3, m4); Literal keeps "facing" and "to the right".

decisions.choice: "upande wa kulia" (to the right)
decisions.reason: Facing east, as the Hebrew way of giving directions does, the right hand is the south. Literal keeps "to the right"; Balanced and Readable say "south", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "hacia la derecha" (L); "hacia el sur" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Hebrew names the south as "the right hand", facing east. Literal keeps the word; Balanced and Readable say "south", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "vers la droite" kept at Literal
decisions.reason: For someone facing east, as Hebrew orients itself, the right hand is the south. Literal keeps the picture; Balanced and Readable say "vers le sud", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "về bên phải" at Literal; "về phía nam" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Facing east, the right hand is the south (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Hebrew picture.

decisions.choice: "오른쪽으로" (L); "남쪽으로" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Facing east, the right hand is the south (meaning decision m4). Literal keeps the Hebrew way of saying it; Balanced and Readable give the direction.

source.text: לִמְנַשֶּׁ֕ה הָיְתָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ תַּפּ֑וּחַ וְתַפּ֛וּחַ אֶל־גְּב֥וּל מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לִבְנֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: To Manasseh was [the] land of Tappuah; and Tappuah, to [the] border of Manasseh, [was] for [the] sons of Ephraim.

en.L: To Manasseh belonged the land of Tappuah; but Tappuah, on the border of Manasseh, [belonged] to the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Ephraim.
en.B: The land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but the town of Tappuah itself, on Manasseh's border, belonged to the descendants of Ephraim.
en.R: The land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh. But the town of Tappuah, right on Manasseh's border, belonged to Ephraim's descendants.

sw.L: Kwa Manase ilikuwa nchi ya Tapua; lakini Tapua, kwenye mpaka wa Manase, [ilikuwa] ya wana wa Efraimu.
sw.B: Nchi inayozunguka Tapua ilikuwa mali ya Manase, lakini mji wa Tapua wenyewe, ulio kwenye mpaka wa Manase, ulikuwa mali ya wazao wa Efraimu.
sw.R: Nchi inayozunguka Tapua ilikuwa ya Manase. Lakini mji wa Tapua, ulio pale pale kwenye mpaka wa Manase, ulikuwa wa wazao wa Efraimu.

es.L: A Manasés perteneció la tierra de Tapúa; pero Tapúa, junto a la frontera de Manasés, [era] de los hijos de Efraín.
es.B: La tierra de alrededor de Tapúa era de Manasés, pero el pueblo mismo de Tapúa, en la frontera de Manasés, era de los descendientes de Efraín.
es.R: La tierra alrededor de Tapúa era de Manasés. Pero el pueblo de Tapúa, justo en la frontera de Manasés, era de los descendientes de Efraín.

fr.L: À Manassé fut le pays de Tappouah ; mais Tappouah, à la frontière de Manassé, [fut] aux {{gender:descendants|fils}} d’Éphraïm.
fr.B: Le pays autour de Tappouah appartenait à Manassé, mais la ville même de Tappouah, à la frontière de Manassé, appartenait aux descendants d’Éphraïm.
fr.R: Le pays autour de Tappouah appartenait à Manassé. Mais la ville de Tappouah, juste sur la frontière de Manassé, appartenait aux descendants d’Éphraïm.

vi.L: Đất Tháp-bu-a thuộc về Ma-na-se; nhưng Tháp-bu-a, trên ranh giới Ma-na-se, [thuộc] về con cháu Ép-ra-im.
vi.B: Vùng đất quanh Tháp-bu-a thuộc về Ma-na-se, nhưng chính thị trấn Tháp-bu-a, trên ranh giới Ma-na-se, thuộc về con cháu Ép-ra-im.
vi.R: Vùng đất quanh Tháp-bu-a thuộc về Ma-na-se. Nhưng thị trấn Tháp-bu-a, ngay trên ranh giới Ma-na-se, thuộc về con cháu Ép-ra-im.

ko.L: 답부아 땅은 므낫세에게 속하였으나, 므낫세의 경계에 있는 답부아는 에브라임 자손에게 [속하였다].
ko.B: 답부아 주변 땅은 므낫세에게 속하였으나, 므낫세의 경계에 있는 답부아 성읍은 에브라임 자손에게 속하였다.
ko.R: 답부아 둘레의 땅은 므낫세 지파의 것이었다. 그러나 므낫세 땅의 경계에 바로 붙어 있는 답부아 성읍은 에브라임 자손의 것이었다.

decisions.choice: the land of Tappuah and Tappuah: the fields around the town and the town itself
decisions.reason: The verse sets the countryside of Tappuah against the town. The fields were Manasseh's, while the town on the border went to Ephraim. Joshua 16:9 says Ephraim had other towns inside Manasseh's land, and verse 9 here says the same.

decisions.choice: the land around ... the town of Tappuah itself
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "around" and "the town" so that the two uses of the name can be told apart (m1).

source.text: וְיָרַ֣ד הַגְּבוּל֩ נַ֨חַל קָנָ֜ה נֶ֣גְבָּה לַנַּ֗חַל עָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֨לֶּה֙ לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּת֖וֹךְ עָרֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וּגְב֤וּל מְנַשֶּׁה֙ מִצְּפ֣וֹן לַנַּ֔חַל וַיְהִ֥י תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And went down the border [to the] wadi of Kanah, southward to the wadi; these cities [were] to Ephraim in [the] midst of [the] cities of Manasseh; and [the] border of Manasseh [was] from [the] north of the wadi, and were its goings out at the sea.

en.L: And the border goes down to the wadi of Kanah, south of the wadi. These cities [belonged] to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh; and the border of Manasseh [is] on the north side of the wadi, and its end is at the sea.
en.B: Then the border goes down to the Wadi Kanah. South of the wadi there were towns that belonged to Ephraim, though they lay among the towns of Manasseh. Manasseh's border runs along the north side of the wadi and ends at the sea.
en.R: Then the border went down to the Wadi Kanah, a stream that is dry most of the year. Some towns south of the wadi belonged to Ephraim, even though they were among Manasseh's towns. Manasseh's border ran along the north side of the wadi and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

sw.L: Na mpaka unashuka hadi korongo la Kana, kusini mwa korongo. Miji hii [ilikuwa] ya Efraimu katikati ya miji ya Manase; na mpaka wa Manase [ni] upande wa kaskazini wa korongo, na mwisho wake ni baharini.
sw.B: Kisha mpaka unashuka hadi Bonde la Kana. Kusini mwa bonde hilo kulikuwa na miji iliyokuwa ya Efraimu, ingawa ilikuwa kati ya miji ya Manase. Mpaka wa Manase unapita upande wa kaskazini wa bonde na kuishia baharini.
sw.R: Kisha mpaka ulishuka hadi Bonde la Kana, mkondo ambao huwa mkavu karibu mwaka mzima. Baadhi ya miji iliyo kusini mwa bonde hilo ilikuwa ya Efraimu, ingawa ilikuwa kati ya miji ya Manase. Mpaka wa Manase ulipita upande wa kaskazini wa bonde, ukaishia Bahari ya Mediterania.

es.L: Y baja la frontera al torrente de Caná, al sur del torrente. Estas ciudades [eran] de Efraín en medio de las ciudades de Manasés; y la frontera de Manasés [está] al norte del torrente, y sus salidas están en el mar.
es.B: Luego la frontera baja al torrente de Caná. Al sur del torrente había poblaciones que eran de Efraín, aunque estaban entre las poblaciones de Manasés. La frontera de Manasés va por el lado norte del torrente y termina en el mar.
es.R: Luego la frontera bajaba al torrente de Caná, un arroyo que está seco casi todo el año. Algunos pueblos al sur del torrente eran de Efraín, aunque estaban entre los pueblos de Manasés. La frontera de Manasés iba por el lado norte del torrente y terminaba en el mar Mediterráneo.

fr.L: Et la frontière descend vers le torrent de Kana, au sud du torrent. Ces villes [furent] à Éphraïm au milieu des villes de Manassé ; et la frontière de Manassé [est] au nord du torrent, et ses issues sont à la mer.
fr.B: Puis la frontière descend vers le torrent de Kana. Au sud du torrent, il y avait des villes qui appartenaient à Éphraïm, bien qu’elles soient au milieu des villes de Manassé. La frontière de Manassé longe le côté nord du torrent et aboutit à la mer.
fr.R: Ensuite, la frontière descendait jusqu’au torrent de Kana, un cours d’eau à sec la plus grande partie de l’année. Quelques villes au sud du torrent appartenaient à Éphraïm, même si elles étaient au milieu des villes de Manassé. La frontière de Manassé longeait le côté nord du torrent et se terminait à la mer Méditerranée.

vi.L: Ranh giới đi xuống khe Ca-na, phía nam khe. Các thành này [thuộc] về Ép-ra-im ở giữa các thành của Ma-na-se; và ranh giới Ma-na-se [ở] phía bắc khe, và cuối của nó là ở biển.
vi.B: Rồi ranh giới đi xuống khe Ca-na. Phía nam khe có những thị trấn thuộc về Ép-ra-im, dù nằm giữa các thị trấn của Ma-na-se. Ranh giới Ma-na-se chạy dọc phía bắc khe và dừng lại ở biển.
vi.R: Rồi ranh giới đi xuống khe Ca-na, một dòng suối khô cạn gần như quanh năm. Có mấy thị trấn ở phía nam khe thuộc về Ép-ra-im, dù chúng nằm giữa các thị trấn của Ma-na-se. Ranh giới Ma-na-se chạy dọc phía bắc khe và dừng lại ở Địa Trung Hải.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 가나 시내로, 시내 남쪽으로 내려간다. 므낫세의 성읍들 가운데 있는 이 성읍들은 에브라임에게 [속하였다]. 그리고 므낫세의 경계는 시내 북쪽에 [있고], 그 끝은 바다이다.
ko.B: 그다음에 경계는 가나 시내로 내려간다. 시내 남쪽에는 에브라임에게 속한 성읍들이 므낫세의 성읍들 가운데 있었다. 므낫세의 경계는 시내 북쪽을 따라가서 바다에서 끝난다.
ko.R: 그다음에 경계는 가나 시내로 내려갔다. 그 시내는 한 해의 대부분 말라 있다. 시내 남쪽에 있는 몇몇 성읍은 므낫세의 성읍들 가운데 있었지만 에브라임의 것이었다. 므낫세의 경계는 시내 북쪽을 따라가서 지중해에서 끝났다.

decisions.choice: the wadi of Kanah: a stream bed running west to the sea
decisions.reason: A wadi is a valley whose stream flows only in the rainy season. The Wadi Kanah ran west from the hills to the Mediterranean and formed part of the line between Ephraim and Manasseh (16:8).

decisions.choice: these cities: Ephraim's towns south of the wadi, inside Manasseh's land
decisions.reason: The verse does not name "these cities". It most likely refers to towns lying south of the wadi that were given to Ephraim though they stood among Manasseh's towns, as 16:9 says. The Hebrew is brief here, and the exact sense of the clause is not certain.

decisions.choice: its goings out: its end
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:4-5, the word means the farthest point a border reaches. The northern line between the two tribes ends at the Mediterranean coast.

decisions.choice: wadi (L), Wadi Kanah (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 16:8, Literal says "wadi" and Balanced and Readable use it as part of the name; Readable explains it and names the sea. Literal and Balanced describe the line in the present tense, as in 15:3.

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word covers any walled settlement, large or small; Balanced and Readable say "towns", which fits the size of most of these places. Literal keeps "cities".

source.text: נֶ֣גְבָּה לְאֶפְרַ֗יִם וְצָפ֨וֹנָה֙ לִמְנַשֶּׁ֔ה וַיְהִ֥י הַיָּ֖ם גְּבוּל֑וֹ וּבְאָשֵׁר֙ יִפְגְּע֣וּן מִצָּפ֔וֹן וּבְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר מִמִּזְרָֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: Southward [was] to Ephraim and northward to Manasseh, and was the sea its border; and on Asher they touch from [the] north, and on Issachar from [the] east.

en.L: Southward [it belonged] to Ephraim and northward to Manasseh, and the sea [is] its border; and they touch Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
en.B: The land to the south belonged to Ephraim and the land to the north to Manasseh, with the sea as its border. Manasseh reaches Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
en.R: Ephraim had the land to the south, and Manasseh had the land to the north. The sea was Manasseh's western border. On the north its land touched the land of Asher, and on the east the land of Issachar.

sw.L: Kusini [ilikuwa] ya Efraimu na kaskazini ya Manase, na bahari [ni] mpaka wake; na wanapakana na Asheri upande wa kaskazini, na Isakari upande wa mashariki.
sw.B: Nchi ya upande wa kusini ilikuwa ya Efraimu, na ya upande wa kaskazini ilikuwa ya Manase, bahari ikiwa mpaka wake. Manase inapakana na Asheri upande wa kaskazini na Isakari upande wa mashariki.
sw.R: Efraimu walikuwa na nchi ya upande wa kusini, na Manase walikuwa na nchi ya upande wa kaskazini. Bahari ilikuwa mpaka wa magharibi wa Manase. Upande wa kaskazini nchi yake ilipakana na nchi ya Asheri, na upande wa mashariki na nchi ya Isakari.

es.L: Al sur [era] de Efraín y al norte de Manasés, y el mar [es] su frontera; y tocan a Aser por el norte, y a Isacar por el oriente.
es.B: La tierra del sur era de Efraín y la del norte de Manasés, con el mar como frontera. Manasés llega hasta Aser por el norte y hasta Isacar por el oriente.
es.R: Efraín tenía la tierra del sur, y Manasés la del norte. El mar era la frontera oeste de Manasés. Por el norte su tierra tocaba la tierra de Aser, y por el este la de Isacar.

fr.L: Au sud [c’était] à Éphraïm, et au nord à Manassé, et la mer [est] sa frontière ; et ils touchent à Aser au nord, et à Issacar à l’orient.
fr.B: Le pays au sud appartenait à Éphraïm, et celui du nord à Manassé, avec la mer pour frontière. Manassé touche à Aser au nord et à Issacar à l’est.
fr.R: Éphraïm avait le pays du sud, et Manassé celui du nord. La mer était la frontière ouest de Manassé. Au nord, son pays touchait celui d’Aser, et à l’est celui d’Issacar.

vi.L: Phía nam [thuộc] về Ép-ra-im, phía bắc về Ma-na-se, và biển [là] ranh giới của nó; họ giáp A-se về phía bắc và Y-sa-ca về phía đông.
vi.B: Đất phía nam thuộc về Ép-ra-im, đất phía bắc thuộc về Ma-na-se, và biển làm ranh giới. Ma-na-se giáp A-se về phía bắc và Y-sa-ca về phía đông.
vi.R: Ép-ra-im có đất ở phía nam, còn Ma-na-se có đất ở phía bắc. Biển là ranh giới phía tây của Ma-na-se. Về phía bắc, đất của Ma-na-se giáp đất A-se, và về phía đông giáp đất Y-sa-ca.

ko.L: 남쪽은 에브라임에게, 북쪽은 므낫세에게 [속하였고], 바다가 그 경계이다. 그리고 그들은 북쪽으로 아셀에, 동쪽으로 잇사갈에 닿는다.
ko.B: 남쪽 땅은 에브라임에게, 북쪽 땅은 므낫세에게 속하였고, 바다가 그 경계이다. 므낫세는 북쪽으로 아셀에, 동쪽으로 잇사갈에 닿는다.
ko.R: 에브라임은 남쪽 땅을, 므낫세는 북쪽 땅을 가졌다. 바다가 므낫세의 서쪽 경계였다. 므낫세 땅은 북쪽으로 아셀 땅에, 동쪽으로 잇사갈 땅에 닿았다.

decisions.choice: they touch: Manasseh's people, spoken of as many
decisions.reason: The verb is plural, though Manasseh has just been named as one tribe. The tribe is thought of as its people, whose land meets the land of Asher and Issachar. The meaning is not affected.

decisions.choice: Asher and Issachar: the tribes to the north and east
decisions.reason: Here Asher is the tribe, whose land lay along the coast to the north (19:24-31), and Issachar lay to the north-east around the Valley of Jezreel (19:17-23). The verse sums up Manasseh's neighbors on each side.

decisions.choice: the sea was its border: the western edge
decisions.reason: The Mediterranean formed the western side of Manasseh's land, as it did for Judah and Ephraim (15:12; 16:8).

decisions.choice: western border
decisions.reason: Readable says which border the sea formed (m3), which Literal and Balanced leave to the reader.

source.text: וַיְהִ֨י לִמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה בְּיִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּבְאָשֵׁ֗ר בֵּית־שְׁאָ֣ן וּ֠בְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיִבְלְעָ֨ם וּבְנוֹתֶ֜יהָ וְֽאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֧י דֹ֣אר וּבְנוֹתֶ֗יהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֤י עֵֽין־דֹּר֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֤י תַעְנַךְ֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י מְגִדּ֖וֹ וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַנָּֽפֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And was to Manasseh in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and its daughters, and Ibleam and its daughters, and [the] inhabitants of Dor and its daughters, and [the] inhabitants of En-dor and its daughters, and [the] inhabitants of Taanach and its daughters, and [the] inhabitants of Megiddo and its daughters; three [of] the heights.

en.L: And Manasseh had, in Issachar and in Asher, Beth-shean and its villages, and Ibleam and its villages, and the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, and the inhabitants of En-dor and its villages, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its villages, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages: the three of the heights.
en.B: In the land of Issachar and Asher, Manasseh also had Beth-shean, Ibleam, and the people of Dor, En-dor, Taanach and Megiddo, each with its villages: the three hill districts.
en.R: Manasseh was also given some towns inside the lands of Issachar and Asher. These were Beth-shean, Ibleam, Dor, En-dor, Taanach and Megiddo, with the people who lived in them and the villages around each town. They made up the three hill districts.

sw.L: Na Manase alikuwa na, katika Isakari na katika Asheri, Beth-sheani na vijiji vyake, na Ibleamu na vijiji vyake, na wakaaji wa Dori na vijiji vyake, na wakaaji wa En-dori na vijiji vyake, na wakaaji wa Taanaki na vijiji vyake, na wakaaji wa Megido na vijiji vyake: ile mitatu ya vilimani.
sw.B: Katika nchi ya Isakari na Asheri, Manase alikuwa pia na Beth-sheani, Ibleamu, na watu wa Dori, En-dori, Taanaki na Megido, kila mmoja pamoja na vijiji vyake: ile mikoa mitatu ya vilimani.
sw.R: Manase walipewa pia miji kadhaa ndani ya nchi za Isakari na Asheri. Miji hiyo ilikuwa Beth-sheani, Ibleamu, Dori, En-dori, Taanaki na Megido, pamoja na watu walioishi humo na vijiji vilivyozunguka kila mji. Ilikuwa ile mikoa mitatu ya vilimani.

es.L: Y tuvo Manasés, en Isacar y en Aser, Bet-seán y sus aldeas, e Ibleam y sus aldeas, y los habitantes de Dor y sus aldeas, y los habitantes de En-dor y sus aldeas, y los habitantes de Taanac y sus aldeas, y los habitantes de Meguido y sus aldeas: las tres alturas.
es.B: En la tierra de Isacar y de Aser, Manasés tuvo también Bet-seán, Ibleam y la gente de Dor, En-dor, Taanac y Meguido, cada una con sus aldeas: los tres distritos de las colinas.
es.R: Manasés recibió también algunos pueblos dentro de las tierras de Isacar y de Aser. Eran Bet-seán, Ibleam, Dor, En-dor, Taanac y Meguido, con la gente que vivía en ellos y las aldeas de alrededor de cada pueblo. Formaban los tres distritos de las colinas.

fr.L: Et Manassé eut, en Issacar et en Aser, Beth-Shean et ses villages, et Jibleam et ses villages, et les habitants de Dor et ses villages, et les habitants d’En-Dor et ses villages, et les habitants de Taanak et ses villages, et les habitants de Meguiddo et ses villages : les trois des hauteurs.
fr.B: Dans les territoires d’Issacar et d’Aser, Manassé eut aussi Beth-Shean, Jibleam, et les habitants de Dor, d’En-Dor, de Taanak et de Meguiddo, chacune avec ses villages : les trois districts des hauteurs.
fr.R: Manassé a aussi reçu quelques villes dans les pays d’Issacar et d’Aser. C’étaient Beth-Shean, Jibleam, Dor, En-Dor, Taanak et Meguiddo, avec leurs habitants et les villages autour de chaque ville. Elles formaient les trois districts des collines.

vi.L: Trong Y-sa-ca và trong A-se, Ma-na-se có Bết-Sê-an và các làng của nó, Íp-lê-am và các làng của nó, dân cư Đô-rơ và các làng của nó, dân cư Ên-Đô-rơ và các làng của nó, dân cư Tha-a-nác và các làng của nó, và dân cư Mê-ghi-đô và các làng của nó: ba vùng đồi cao.
vi.B: Trong đất Y-sa-ca và A-se, Ma-na-se cũng có Bết-Sê-an, Íp-lê-am, và dân cư Đô-rơ, Ên-Đô-rơ, Tha-a-nác và Mê-ghi-đô, mỗi nơi cùng các làng của nó: ba vùng đồi.
vi.R: Ma-na-se cũng được ban mấy thị trấn trong đất Y-sa-ca và A-se. Đó là Bết-Sê-an, Íp-lê-am, Đô-rơ, Ên-Đô-rơ, Tha-a-nác và Mê-ghi-đô, cùng với dân sống ở đó và các làng chung quanh mỗi thị trấn. Các nơi ấy hợp thành ba vùng đồi.

ko.L: 그리고 므낫세에게는 잇사갈과 아셀 안에 벧스안과 그 딸들, 이블르암과 그 딸들, 돌 주민과 그 딸들, 엔돌 주민과 그 딸들, 다아낙 주민과 그 딸들, 므깃도 주민과 그 딸들이 있었으니, 세 고지이다.
ko.B: 므낫세는 잇사갈과 아셀 땅 안에서도 벧스안, 이블르암, 그리고 돌, 엔돌, 다아낙, 므깃도의 주민들을 각각 그 마을들과 함께 차지하였으니, 곧 세 언덕 지역이다.
ko.R: 므낫세 지파는 잇사갈과 아셀 땅 안에서도 몇몇 성읍을 받았다. 그 성읍들은 벧스안, 이블르암, 돌, 엔돌, 다아낙, 므깃도였고, 거기 사는 사람들과 성읍마다 딸린 마을들도 함께 받았다. 이곳들이 세 언덕 지역을 이루었다.

decisions.choice: its daughters: the villages that belonged to a town
decisions.reason: A town's "daughters" are the smaller settlements around it that depended on it, as in Numbers 21:25, 32.

decisions.choice: Beth-shean, Ibleam, Dor, En-dor, Taanach, Megiddo: strong Canaanite towns along the valleys
decisions.reason: These towns guarded the Valley of Jezreel and the coastal plain, the main roads across the north of the land. Beth-shean stood where the valley meets the Jordan (verse 16), Megiddo and Taanach on the valley's south-west edge, and Dor on the coast. Though they lay in or beside the land of Issachar and Asher, they were given to Manasseh. Verse 12 says Manasseh could not take them; Judges 1:27 lists the same towns.

decisions.choice: the three of the heights: an unclear phrase, probably naming three hill districts
decisions.reason: The last words are hard to explain. The word may mean "height" or "hill region", and the phrase may refer to three of the towns just named that stood on high ground, or to districts linked with Naphath-dor, the heights of Dor (11:2; 12:23). It could also be read "the third is Napheth", a note on Dor. The rendering keeps the most likely sense.

decisions.choice: the inhabitants of Dor: the people as well as the towns
decisions.reason: From Dor on, the list names "the inhabitants of" each town. The change prepares for verse 12, where those inhabitants, the Canaanites, stay in the land.

decisions.choice: each with its villages
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "with its villages" once for the whole list rather than after every name. Literal keeps the repetition.

decisions.choice: "ses villages" at Literal for "its daughters"
decisions.reason: Here French follows the English Literal, which renders "its daughters" as "its villages" in this verse; the picture of "daughters" is kept at 15:45-47, where the English keeps it.

decisions.choice: "các làng của nó" at Literal for "its daughters"
decisions.reason: Here the "daughters" of each town are its villages (meaning decision); Vietnamese says so plainly, since "thành con" would suggest walled towns.

decisions.choice: "세 고지" (L); "세 언덕 지역" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The phrase is unclear (meaning decision m3); it is taken, as the English takes it, to name three hill districts. Literal keeps it short as the Hebrew does, and "딸들" for the villages, as in 15:45.

source.text: וְלֹ֤א יָכְלוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לְהוֹרִ֖ישׁ אֶת־הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיּ֨וֹאֶל֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And not were able [the] sons of Manasseh to take possession of these cities; and was determined the Canaanite to dwell in this land.

en.L: But the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Manasseh were not able to take possession of these cities, and the Canaanites were determined to dwell in this land.
en.B: But the descendants of Manasseh could not take over these towns, because the Canaanites were determined to stay in that land.
en.R: But Manasseh's descendants could not take over those towns. The Canaanites refused to leave that part of the land.

sw.L: Lakini wana wa Manase hawakuweza kuimiliki miji hii, na Wakanaani walikuwa wameazimia kukaa katika nchi hii.
sw.B: Lakini wazao wa Manase hawakuweza kuitwaa miji hiyo, kwa sababu Wakanaani walikuwa wameazimia kubaki katika nchi ile.
sw.R: Lakini wazao wa Manase hawakuweza kuitwaa miji hiyo. Wakanaani walikataa kuondoka katika sehemu ile ya nchi.

es.L: Pero los hijos de Manasés no pudieron tomar posesión de estas ciudades, y los cananeos se empeñaron en habitar en esta tierra.
es.B: Pero los descendientes de Manasés no pudieron apoderarse de estas poblaciones, porque los cananeos estaban resueltos a quedarse en aquella tierra.
es.R: Pero los descendientes de Manasés no pudieron tomar esos pueblos. Los cananeos se negaron a irse de esa parte de la tierra.

fr.L: Mais les {{gender:descendants|fils}} de Manassé ne purent pas prendre possession de ces villes, et les Cananéens tenaient à habiter dans ce pays.
fr.B: Mais les descendants de Manassé ne purent pas s’emparer de ces villes, car les Cananéens étaient décidés à rester dans ce pays.
fr.R: Mais les descendants de Manassé n’ont pas pu prendre ces villes. Les Cananéens refusaient de quitter cette partie du pays.

vi.L: Nhưng con cháu Ma-na-se không thể chiếm hữu các thành này, và người Ca-na-an quyết ở lại trong xứ này.
vi.B: Nhưng con cháu Ma-na-se không chiếm được các thị trấn ấy, vì người Ca-na-an nhất quyết ở lại trong xứ đó.
vi.R: Nhưng con cháu Ma-na-se không chiếm được các thị trấn ấy. Người Ca-na-an không chịu rời khỏi vùng đất đó.

ko.L: 그러나 므낫세 자손이 이 성읍들을 차지할 수 없었고, 가나안 사람이 이 땅에 계속 살기로 작정하였다.
ko.B: 그러나 므낫세 자손은 이 성읍들을 차지할 수 없었다. 가나안 사람들이 그 땅에 눌러살기로 작정하였기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러나 므낫세 자손은 그 성읍들을 차지하지 못하였다. 가나안 사람들이 그 땅을 떠나려 하지 않았다.

decisions.choice: take possession of: take over by driving out those living there
decisions.reason: The verb means to take possession, often by dispossessing the people already there. The tribe was given the towns but could not make them its own (Judges 1:27).

decisions.choice: was determined: set on staying, refused to leave
decisions.reason: The verb means to resolve or be willing to do something. The Canaanites held on and would not give up their land (Judges 1:27, 35).

decisions.choice: the Canaanite: the Canaanites as a people
decisions.reason: The word is singular, "the Canaanite", used for the whole people, as often in lists of nations (Deuteronomy 7:1).

decisions.choice: because
decisions.reason: Balanced joins the two clauses with "because", since the second gives the reason for the first. Literal keeps "and"; Readable uses two sentences.

source.text: וַֽיְהִ֗י כִּ֤י חָֽזְקוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ אֶת־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י לָמַ֑ס וְהוֹרֵ֖שׁ לֹ֥א הוֹרִישֽׁוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when grew strong [the] sons of Israel, and they put the Canaanite to forced labor; and dispossessing not he dispossessed him.

en.L: And it came about, when the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel grew strong, that they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but they did not fully dispossess them.
en.B: Later, when the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had grown stronger, they made the Canaanites do forced labor, but they never drove them out completely.
en.R: In time the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} became stronger. Then they made the Canaanites work for them as forced laborers. But the Israelites never drove all of them out.

sw.L: Na ikawa, wana wa Israeli walipopata nguvu, wakawatia Wakanaani katika kazi ya kulazimishwa, lakini hawakuwafukuza kabisa.
sw.B: Baadaye, Waisraeli walipokuwa na nguvu zaidi, waliwalazimisha Wakanaani kufanya kazi za kutumikishwa, lakini hawakuwafukuza kabisa kamwe.
sw.R: Baada ya muda Waisraeli walipata nguvu zaidi. Ndipo walipowalazimisha Wakanaani kuwafanyia kazi ngumu. Lakini Waisraeli hawakuwafukuza wote kamwe.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando los hijos de Israel se hicieron fuertes, sometieron a los cananeos a trabajo forzado, pero no los desposeyeron del todo.
es.B: Más tarde, cuando los israelitas se hicieron más fuertes, obligaron a los cananeos a hacer trabajos forzados, pero nunca los expulsaron del todo.
es.R: Con el tiempo los israelitas se hicieron más fuertes. Entonces obligaron a los cananeos a trabajar para ellos en trabajos forzados. Pero los israelitas nunca los echaron a todos.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël devinrent forts, qu’ils mirent les Cananéens à la corvée ; mais ils ne les dépossédèrent pas entièrement.
fr.B: Plus tard, quand les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} furent devenus plus forts, ils astreignirent les Cananéens aux travaux forcés, mais ils ne les chassèrent jamais complètement.
fr.R: Avec le temps, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} sont devenus plus forts. Alors ils ont obligé les Cananéens à travailler pour eux de force. Mais les Israélites ne les ont jamais tous chassés.

vi.L: Khi con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên trở nên mạnh, họ bắt người Ca-na-an làm lao dịch, nhưng không đuổi họ đi hết.
vi.B: Về sau, khi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã mạnh hơn, họ bắt người Ca-na-an làm lao dịch, nhưng không bao giờ đuổi họ đi hết.
vi.R: Dần dần dân Y-sơ-ra-ên mạnh hơn. Bấy giờ họ bắt người Ca-na-an làm lao dịch cho mình. Nhưng dân Y-sơ-ra-ên không bao giờ đuổi hết họ đi.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 강해졌을 때 그들이 가나안 사람에게 강제 노역을 시켰으나, 그를 다 쫓아내지는 않았다.
ko.B: 나중에 이스라엘 자손이 더 강해지자 가나안 사람들에게 강제 노역을 시켰으나, 그들을 끝내 다 쫓아내지는 않았다.
ko.R: 시간이 지나 이스라엘 백성이 더 강해졌다. 그러자 그들은 가나안 사람들에게 강제로 일을 시켰다. 그러나 이스라엘 백성은 그들을 모두 쫓아내지는 않았다.

decisions.choice: forced labor: work demanded of a subject people
decisions.reason: The word means a body of forced workers, or the labor they owed. Israel made the Canaanites serve them in this way rather than driving them out, as Deuteronomy 20:11 allowed for a distant city that made peace, but not for the peoples of the land itself (Deuteronomy 20:16-17). Solomon later used such forced workers (1 Kings 9:20-21).

decisions.choice: dispossessing he did not dispossess: they did not drive them out completely
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis, and the negative goes with the whole: they did not carry the work through. The verb and object are singular, "he" and "him", treating Israel and the Canaanites each as one people.

decisions.choice: when Israel grew strong: they could have driven them out but did not
decisions.reason: The verse says the failure was not only weakness. Once Israel was strong enough, it chose to profit from the Canaanites' labor. Judges 1:28 repeats the verse, and Judges 2:1-3 gives the LORD's judgment on it.

decisions.choice: drove them out (B, R); dispossess (L)
decisions.reason: For peoples, Literal says "dispossess" and Balanced and Readable "drive out", the wording used for this verb through Numbers to Ruth.

source.text: וַֽיְדַבְּרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּוּעַ֩ נָתַ֨תָּה לִּ֜י נַחֲלָ֗ה גּוֹרָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ וְחֶ֣בֶל אֶחָ֔ד וַֽאֲנִ֣י עַם־רָ֔ב עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־עַד־כֹּ֖ה בֵּֽרְכַ֥נִי יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke [the] sons of Joseph with Joshua, saying, why have you given to me [as] inheritance one lot and one portion, and I [am] a people numerous, inasmuch as until thus has blessed me Yahweh?

en.L: And the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, "Why have you given me [as] an inheritance one lot and one portion, when I [am] a numerous people, since {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed me so far?"
en.B: Joseph's descendants asked Joshua, "Why have you given us just one allotment, a single share, as our inheritance? We are a large people, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed us until now."
en.R: Joseph's descendants said to Joshua, "Why did you give us only one share of the land? There are so many of us, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed us greatly."

sw.L: Na wana wa Yusufu wakamwambia Yoshua, wakisema, "Mbona umenipa [kuwa] urithi kura moja na fungu moja, nami [ni] watu wengi, kwa kuwa hadi sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenibariki?"
sw.B: Wazao wa Yusufu walimwuliza Yoshua, "Kwa nini umetupa fungu moja tu, sehemu moja, kuwa urithi wetu? Sisi ni watu wengi, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametubariki mpaka sasa."
sw.R: Wazao wa Yusufu walimwambia Yoshua, "Kwa nini umetupa sehemu moja tu ya nchi? Sisi ni wengi sana, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametubariki sana."

es.L: Y hablaron los hijos de José a Josué, diciendo: «¿Por qué me has dado [por] heredad una sola suerte y una sola porción, siendo yo un pueblo numeroso, ya que hasta ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha bendecido?».
es.B: Los descendientes de José le preguntaron a Josué: «¿Por qué nos has dado como heredad una sola porción, una sola parte? Somos un pueblo numeroso, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos ha bendecido hasta ahora».
es.R: Los descendientes de José le dijeron a Josué: «¿Por qué nos diste solo una parte de la tierra? Somos muchísimos, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos ha bendecido mucho».

fr.L: Et les {{gender:descendants|fils}} de Joseph parlèrent à Josué, en disant : « Pourquoi m’as-tu donné [en] héritage un seul sort et une seule part, alors que je [suis] un peuple nombreux, puisque jusqu’ici {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a béni ? »
fr.B: Les descendants de Joseph dirent à Josué : « Pourquoi nous as-tu donné en héritage un seul lot, une seule part ? Nous sommes un peuple nombreux, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous a bénis jusqu’à présent. »
fr.R: Les descendants de Joseph ont dit à Josué : « Pourquoi nous as-tu donné seulement une part du pays ? Nous sommes très nombreux, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous a beaucoup bénis. »

vi.L: Con cháu Giô-sép nói với Giô-suê: "Sao ông chỉ cho tôi một thăm và một phần [làm] sản nghiệp, trong khi tôi [là] một dân đông đúc, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước cho tôi đến nay?"
vi.B: Con cháu Giô-sép hỏi Giô-suê: "Sao ông chỉ cho chúng tôi một phần bắt thăm, một phần đất duy nhất, làm sản nghiệp? Chúng tôi là một dân đông đúc, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước cho chúng tôi đến nay."
vi.R: Con cháu Giô-sép nói với Giô-suê: "Sao ông chỉ cho chúng tôi một phần đất thôi? Chúng tôi đông người lắm, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước dồi dào cho chúng tôi."

ko.L: 그리고 요셉 자손이 여호수아에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 지금까지 나에게 복을 주셔서 내가 큰 민족이 되었는데, 어찌하여 당신은 나에게 한 제비와 한 몫만 유산으로 주었습니까?"
ko.B: 요셉 자손이 여호수아에게 물었다. "어찌하여 우리에게 한 몫, 단 한 차례의 제비로만 유산을 주셨습니까? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 지금까지 우리에게 복을 주셔서 우리는 큰 민족이 되었습니다."
ko.R: 요셉의 자손이 여호수아에게 말했다. "어찌하여 우리에게 땅을 한 몫만 주셨습니까? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리에게 큰 복을 주셔서 우리는 수가 아주 많습니다."

decisions.choice: me, I: the tribes speak as one people
decisions.reason: The descendants of Joseph speak in the singular, "me" and "I", as one people, the house of Joseph (verse 17). The meaning is "us" and "we".

decisions.choice: one lot and one portion: one share for the two tribes of Joseph
decisions.reason: Joseph's sons Ephraim and Manasseh were counted as two tribes (Genesis 48:5), and Manasseh's land has just been described apart from Ephraim's. But it came by a single lot (16:1), and Joseph's descendants complain that it is too small for two large tribes. "Portion" is the measured piece of land, as in verse 5.

decisions.choice: a numerous people whom the LORD has blessed
decisions.reason: Their numbers are the blessing promised to Joseph's sons (Genesis 48:4, 16, 19-20; 49:22). The census counted 52,700 men of Manasseh and 32,500 of Ephraim (Numbers 26:34, 37).

decisions.choice: us, we
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use "us" and "we", as the plural speakers mean (m1). Literal keeps the singular, and Balanced adds "just" to bring out the complaint in "one lot".

decisions.choice: "me", "yo" (L) and "nos", "somos" (B, R) for Joseph's people; Joshua's answer in "tú" at Literal, in plural forms at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of the house of Joseph as one person, "I" and "you" in the singular, through verse 18. Literal keeps the singular; Balanced and Readable speak of the many people they are, as the English does, so Joshua's answer there takes the plural forms of the plural-you setting.

decisions.choice: "m'as-tu donné", "je suis" kept in the singular at Literal
decisions.reason: The tribes of Joseph speak as one people, "me" and "I". Literal keeps the singular; Balanced and Readable say "nous", as the English says "us".

decisions.choice: The tribes of Joseph speak as "tôi" (Literal) and "chúng tôi" (Balanced, Readable) and call Joshua "ông"; Joshua answers them as "anh em"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's single speaker for the people (meaning decision). Joshua, himself of Ephraim, speaks to his own kin as a leader among them, not as a master.

decisions.choice: Joseph's descendants speak to Joshua in the formal polite style (합쇼체); "나" (L) and "우리" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The tribes speak as one people, "me" and "I" in the Hebrew (meaning decision m1); Literal keeps the singular, and Balanced and Readable say "우리", as the English does. Their complaint is bold, so they keep "우리" rather than the humbler "저희". Joshua answers them in the plain style as their leader.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ אִם־עַם־רַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ עֲלֵ֣ה לְךָ֣ הַיַּ֔עְרָה וּבֵרֵאתָ֤ לְךָ֙ שָׁ֔ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַפְּרִזִּ֖י וְהָֽרְפָאִ֑ים כִּֽי־אָ֥ץ לְךָ֖ הַר־אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to them Joshua, if a people numerous [are] you, go up for yourself to the forest and cut down for yourself there in [the] land of the Perizzite and the Rephaim, since is narrow for you [the] hill country of Ephraim.

en.L: And Joshua said to them, "If you [are] a numerous people, go up for yourself to the forest and cut [it] down for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you."
en.B: Joshua answered them, "If you are so many, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves there, in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you."
en.R: Joshua answered, "If there are so many of you, and the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, then go up into the forest. Cut down the trees there and make room for yourselves in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim."

sw.L: Na Yoshua akawaambia, "Kama [ninyi ni] watu wengi, pandeni msituni mkajikatie [nafasi] huko katika nchi ya Waperizi na Warefai, kwa kuwa nchi ya milima ya Efraimu ni nyembamba mno kwenu."
sw.B: Yoshua akawajibu, "Ikiwa ninyi ni wengi hivyo, pandeni msituni mkajisafishie nchi huko, katika nchi ya Waperizi na Warefai, kwa kuwa nchi ya milima ya Efraimu ni ndogo mno kwenu."
sw.R: Yoshua akajibu, "Ikiwa ninyi ni wengi sana, na nchi ya milima ya Efraimu ni ndogo mno kwenu, basi pandeni msituni. Kateni miti huko mjipatie nafasi katika nchi ya Waperizi na Warefai."

es.L: Y Josué les dijo: «Si [eres] un pueblo numeroso, sube al bosque y desmonta allí para ti en la tierra de los ferezeos y de los refaítas, ya que la región montañosa de Efraín te es estrecha».
es.B: Josué les respondió: «Si {{plural_you:son|sois}} tantos, {{plural_you:suban|subid}} al bosque y {{plural_you:desmonten|desmontad}} allí tierra para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, en la tierra de los ferezeos y de los refaítas, ya que la región montañosa de Efraín {{plural_you:les|os}} queda pequeña».
es.R: Josué les respondió: «Si {{plural_you:son|sois}} tantos y la región montañosa de Efraín {{plural_you:les|os}} queda pequeña, {{plural_you:suban|subid}} al bosque. {{plural_you:Corten|Cortad}} los árboles y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} lugar para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en la tierra de los ferezeos y de los refaítas».

fr.L: Et Josué leur dit : « Si tu [es] un peuple nombreux, monte à la forêt et défriche pour toi là-bas dans le pays des Phéréziens et des Rephaïm, puisque la montagne d’Éphraïm est trop étroite pour toi. »
fr.B: Josué leur répondit : « Si vous êtes si nombreux, montez dans la forêt et défrichez-y des terres pour vous, dans le pays des Phéréziens et des Rephaïm, puisque la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm est trop petite pour vous. »
fr.R: Josué a répondu : « Si vous êtes si nombreux, et si la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm est trop petite pour vous, alors montez dans la forêt. Coupez les arbres et faites-vous de la place dans le pays des Phéréziens et des Rephaïm. »

vi.L: Giô-suê nói với họ: "Nếu anh em [là] một dân đông đúc, hãy tự đi lên rừng và đốn [cây] lấy chỗ cho mình ở đó, trong đất của người Phê-rê-sít và người Rê-pha-im, vì miền núi Ép-ra-im quá chật cho anh em."
vi.B: Giô-suê trả lời họ: "Nếu anh em đông đến thế, hãy đi lên rừng và khai phá đất cho mình ở đó, trong đất của người Phê-rê-sít và người Rê-pha-im, vì miền núi Ép-ra-im quá nhỏ đối với anh em."
vi.R: Giô-suê trả lời: "Nếu anh em đông như vậy, và miền núi Ép-ra-im quá nhỏ đối với anh em, thì hãy đi lên rừng. Hãy đốn cây ở đó và mở chỗ cho mình trong đất của người Phê-rê-sít và người Rê-pha-im."

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 그들에게 말했다. "너희가 큰 민족이라면, 에브라임 산지가 너희에게 좁으니, 너희는 숲으로 올라가서 거기 브리스 사람과 르바임의 땅에서 너희를 위하여 [그것을] 베어 내어라."
ko.B: 여호수아가 그들에게 대답했다. "너희 수가 그렇게 많고 에브라임 산지가 너희에게 좁다면, 숲으로 올라가서 거기 브리스 사람과 르바임의 땅에서 너희가 살 땅을 개간하여라."
ko.R: 여호수아가 대답했다. "너희 수가 그렇게 많고 에브라임 산지가 너희에게 좁다면, 숲으로 올라가거라. 거기 브리스 사람과 르바임의 땅에서 나무를 베어 너희가 살 자리를 만들어라."

decisions.choice: cut down: clear forest land to live on
decisions.reason: The verb in this form means to cut down trees and so clear ground (verse 18; Ezekiel 23:47 uses it of cutting down people with swords). Joshua tells them to make room by clearing the wooded hills.

decisions.choice: the Perizzites and the Rephaim: peoples living in the wooded hills
decisions.reason: The Perizzites are one of the peoples of Canaan (3:10; Genesis 13:7). The Rephaim were an ancient people remembered for their great size (Deuteronomy 2:10-11, 20-21; 3:11). The land Joshua points to was still held by such peoples.

decisions.choice: the hill country of Ephraim: the central hills held by the tribes of Joseph
decisions.reason: The name is used for the hill country of central Canaan as a whole, including the part given to Manasseh, not only Ephraim's share (24:30; Judges 4:5). It is "narrow" for them: too small.

decisions.choice: you: the tribes addressed as one
decisions.reason: Joshua answers in the singular, as they spoke (verse 14).

decisions.choice: cut [it] down (L); clear land (B); cut down the trees ... make room (R)
decisions.reason: The verb has no object. Literal brackets "it", the forest; Balanced and Readable say what the clearing was for.

decisions.choice: the reason first
decisions.reason: Readable puts the clause about the small hill country before the command, so the reason comes before the advice.

decisions.choice: "los ferezeos"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form for the Perizzites, one of the peoples of Canaan named since Genesis 13:7.

decisions.choice: "défricher" (L, B), "coupez les arbres et faites-vous de la place" (R)
